mapper.select: select id, dept_id as deptId, report_id as reportId, kind, role, object_key as objectKey, original_name as originalName, mime_type as mimeType, size_bytes as sizeBytes, sha256, snapshot_sha256 as snapshotSha256 from report_file where id = #{id}

select id, dept_id as deptId, report_id as reportId, kind, role, object_key as objectKey, original_name as originalName, mime_type as mimeType, size_bytes as sizeBytes, sha256, snapshot_sha256 as snapshotSha256 from report_file where dept_id = #{deptId} and snapshot_sha256 = #{snapshotSha256} and role = #{role} order by id desc limit 1

select id, dept_id as deptId, report_id as reportId, kind, role, object_key as objectKey, original_name as originalName, mime_type as mimeType, size_bytes as sizeBytes, sha256, snapshot_sha256 as snapshotSha256 from report_file where report_id = #{reportId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and kind = 'upload' and role in ('cover_logo', 'org_chart', 'office_location') order by id
mapper.delete: delete from report_file where report_id = #{reportId} and dept_id = #{deptId} and kind = 'upload' and role = #{role}
mapper.insert: insert into report_file ( dept_id, report_id, kind, role, object_key, original_name, mime_type, size_bytes, sha256, snapshot_sha256, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{deptId}, #{reportId}, #{kind}, #{role}, #{objectKey}, #{originalName}, #{mimeType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sha256}, #{snapshotSha256}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now() )
